sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents, highlighting how multi-step reasoning and tool use are becoming production-ready. Shared benchmarks showing 3x improvement in agent reliability over the past quarter.

sources.author: Sarah Guo
sources.headline: Founder @ Conviction
sources.post_summary: Analyzed the AI infrastructure landscape, noting that GPU utilization rates have jumped to 85%+ for leading labs. Emphasized the shift from training to inference optimization as the next bottleneck.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI Researcher
sources.post_summary: Shared practical examples of using LLMs for code generation and debugging workflows. Highlighted new open-source tools that reduce context-switching for developers building AI-powered applications.

sources.author: Mustafa Suleyman
sources.headline: CEO @ Microsoft AI
sources.post_summary: Explored the convergence of automation and AI agents in enterprise settings, citing internal Microsoft deployments that reduced manual workflows by 40%. Stressed the importance of human-in-the-loop oversight.

sources.author: Aakash Gupta
sources.headline: Product Growth @ Ramp | Newsletter: Product-Led Growth
sources.post_summary: Discussed how GTM engineering teams are shifting from manual outbound to building automated, data-driven systems that combine intent signals, enrichment, and multi-channel sequencing. Highlighted that modern GTM engineers treat outbound like product development with metrics, experimentation, and infrastructure.

sources.author: Elena Verna
sources.headline: Growth Advisor | Former CMO at Amplitude & Miro
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on revenue operations as the new backbone of scaling companies. Covered how RevOps teams are integrating content strategy with sales enablement and automation to create consistent pipeline generation rather than relying on heroics from individual reps.

sources.author: Harry Stebbings
sources.headline: Founder @ 20VC | Investor
sources.post_summary: Explored how top B2B companies are building outbound automation stacks that combine AI enrichment, intent data, and personalized sequencing. Emphasized that GTM engineering roles are becoming critical for scaling without proportional headcount increases.

sources.author: April Dunford
sources.headline: Positioning & Go-to-Market Expert | Author of Obviously Awesome
sources.post_summary: Discussed the intersection of content strategy and sales ops, arguing that effective GTM requires tight alignment between messaging, content assets, and automated outreach sequences. Shared examples of companies where content-led outbound significantly improved conversion rates.

sources.author: Alex Finn
sources.headline: Solo Founder @ Finndev | Shipping indie tools
sources.post_summary: Shared the journey of building and launching a micro-SaaS in 6 weeks as a solo developer. Highlighted the decision to ship a minimal version without waiting for perfection, and how early user feedback shaped the roadmap. Discussed the challenges of balancing product development with marketing.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Ex-Marketing Manager turned Software Engineer | Career Pivot Stories
sources.post_summary: Detailed her transition from marketing to software engineering after a 9-month self-taught journey. Emphasized the value of building small projects publicly and how sharing progress on LinkedIn helped land her first dev role. Offered advice on overcoming imposter syndrome during the pivot.

sources.author: Marcus Chen
sources.headline: Founder @ DevFlow | Shipping developer tools
sources.post_summary: Posted about launching the beta of his latest developer productivity tool after months of solo development. Included metrics from the first 48 hours post-launch and lessons learned about positioning for a technical audience. Stressed the importance of consistent weekly updates to build an audience.

sources.author: Elena Rodriguez
sources.headline: Indie Hacker & Former PM | Building in Public
sources.post_summary: Shared her experience pivoting from product management to full-time indie development after burnout. Documented the process of validating ideas through public Twitter threads and LinkedIn updates before coding. Highlighted how transparency helped attract early users and collaborators.

sources.author: Jordan Hale
sources.headline: Solo Developer | Shipping side projects to full-time income
sources.post_summary: Wrote about turning a weekend side project into a revenue-generating product over 8 months. Covered the technical stack choices, the decision to stay solo rather than hire, and the financial milestones that allowed quitting his day job. Shared revenue numbers and user growth stats.
